svg.title: Aeonic system architecture
svg.desc: An Excalidraw-style diagram showing a browser reaching the Caddy edge and React dashboard, the Express API and Node media worker sharing persistent data, and the optional AI worker connecting to Qdrant and an external provider.
svg.text: Core media operations stay local; intelligence is an explicit optional path.
Solid = required core path · Dashed purple = opt-in AI profile · Product marks identify their respective open-source components.
